Priya Sharma - Software Engineer

Experience:
Backend Engineer at Meridian Systems (2023-2026)
- Built and maintained REST APIs using Python and FastAPI, serving 2M+ requests/day
- Designed PostgreSQL schemas and optimized slow queries, cutting p95 latency by 40%
- Deployed services to AWS (ECS, RDS, S3) with Terraform-managed infrastructure
- Wrote integration tests with pytest and set up CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions

Backend Intern at Fernwood Data (2022)
- Contributed to a Django-based internal tool for data ingestion
- Wrote SQL queries against a PostgreSQL data warehouse

Projects:
- Personal blog engine built with Flask and SQLite
- Small machine learning side project using scikit-learn to classify support tickets

Skills: Python, FastAPI, Django, Flask, PostgreSQL, AWS, Docker, Git, pytest, SQL

No experience with Kubernetes, Rust, or Swift — these are on my list to learn next.

Jordan Lee - Frontend Engineer

Experience:
Frontend Engineer at Willowmere Retail (2023-2026)
- Built customer-facing features in React and TypeScript for a high-traffic e-commerce site
- Migrated legacy jQuery pages to a modern React + Redux architecture
- Worked closely with designers to implement responsive layouts using Tailwind CSS
- Used Node.js and Express for a small internal BFF (backend-for-frontend) service

Frontend Intern at Clearwater Media (2022)
- Assisted with GraphQL query integration in an existing Apollo Client setup
- Fixed cross-browser CSS bugs and improved Lighthouse accessibility scores

Projects:
- A personal portfolio site built with Next.js and deployed on Vercel
- A Chrome extension written in vanilla JavaScript

Skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Redux, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL

I have no background in machine learning or data science — that's not an area I've worked in.
